criteria.rationale: The recorded birth date makes the patient 56 on the request date, exceeding the minimum age of 18.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the treatment plan addresses overweight with Wegovy.
The latest structured BMI is 29.1, and active dyslipidemia is a qualifying weight-related comorbidity.

The notes document participation in a continuing program with food logging, a reduced-calorie meal plan, and walking. The notes differ on its start date, but either date establishes participation; the policy specifies no minimum duration.
Saxenda is recorded as completed, and the recent note confirms it was stopped in 2024. The draft Wegovy order is excluded from the concurrent-therapy assessment.
The documented prior PA weight-loss medication, Saxenda, was stopped; no other concurrent Appendix 2 medication is documented. The draft Wegovy order is excluded.

parsed.summary: All modeled criteria are met. The latest BMI is 29.1 with active dyslipidemia, comprehensive program participation is documented, and prior Saxenda therapy was stopped. The differing program start dates do not affect eligibility because the policy has no minimum-duration requirement.
